plan.title: AQ-OS Capabilities — skills, workflows, roles, commands (honest)
plan.goal: The agent/system capability surface — skills, workflows, roles, slash-commands, enhancements — on the honest tier scale. DEFINED (file/index exists) is NOT validated: a skill existing doesn't prove it loads or helps; a workflow existing doesn't prove it runs. Most are DEFINED + UNVALIDATED.
success_criteria: Every capability category accounted for with honest counts (65 skills, 26 workflows, 5 roles, 11 commands)
Validated = actually loads/runs/routes correctly, not just 'a file exists'
Owner sign-off before any category counts as done
plan.tier_model: DEFINED=file/index entry exists; INTEGRATED=wired (in index/dispatch/registry); VALIDATED=loads/runs/routes correctly in practice; ACCEPTED=owner signed off. Per-item validation of 65 skills is UNMEASURED — represented honestly at category level with counts, flagged for owner review.
plan.honest_note: FIRST CUT. Counts are real (ls); validation status is largely UNMEASURED. Nothing here is proven working end-to-end just by existing. Percentages reflect DEFINED/partially-wired, capped well below complete.
